# Third-party assets (v0.2)

All art, fonts and map data used by play1 come from the sources below (spec 3.2 — nothing else is downloaded).
The four Kenney sheets and their `License.txt` are committed under this folder; fonts and map data are pulled from npm.

| Asset | Files here | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kenney Roguelike/RPG pack (2015) | `kenney-roguelike-rpg/sheet.png` (`Spritesheet/roguelikeSheet_transparent.png`, 968×526, 57×31 cells) + `License.txt` | https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-rpg-pack | CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| Kenney Roguelike Modern City (2.0) | `kenney-roguelike-city/sheet.png` (`Tilemap/tilemap.png`, 628×475, 37×28 cells) + `License.txt` | https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-modern-city | CC0 1.0 |
| Kenney Roguelike Characters | `kenney-roguelike-characters/sheet.png` (`Spritesheet/roguelikeChar_transparent.png`, 918×203, 54×12 cells) + `License.txt` | https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-characters | CC0 1.0 |
| Kenney Roguelike Indoors | `kenney-roguelike-indoors/sheet.png` (`Tilesheets/roguelikeIndoor_transparent.png`, 458×305, 27×18 cells) + `License.txt` | https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-indoors | CC0 1.0 |
| Galmuri pixel fonts (Galmuri9 / 11 / 11 Bold / 14, woff2) | not copied — imported from `node_modules/galmuri/dist/` by Vite | https://github.com/quiple/galmuri (npm `galmuri`) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`node_modules/galmuri/dist/LICENSE.txt`) |
| world-atlas `land-110m.json` (Natural Earth 1:110m land) | not copied — imported from `node_modules/world-atlas/` | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas (npm `world-atlas`) | ISC (data: Natural Earth, public domain) |
| topojson-client | not copied — npm dependency | https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client | ISC |

Kenney: "You may use these graphics in personal and commercial projects. Credit (Kenney or www.kenney.nl) would be
nice but is not mandatory." — thank you, Kenney.

`manifest.json` in this folder is generated by `scripts/fetch-assets.mjs` and records the zip/sheet SHA-256, sizes and
the measured cell grid of each sheet. Everything else in the game (landmarks, monsters, emoji, UI skin, souvenirs, music,
sound effects) is generated by code in `src/client/assets` and `src/client/audio`.
